answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a photorealistic professional square headshot of ONLY the adult woman with short blonde hair on the RIGHT in the reference photo. Preserve her recognizable identity, facial features, short blonde bob hairstyle, and natural friendly smile. Remove the man entirely. Center the woman alone in a classic head-and-shoulders composition, facing the camera, with comfortable space above her head. Replace beach clothing with a tasteful navy business blazer over a simple cream blouse. Replace the beach with a clean softly blurred light gray studio background. Use flattering soft studio lighting, natural skin texture and realistic proportions. Polished professional business portrait, restrained natural retouching, no text, no logos, no other people.
